name: 3D printer
title: Slice, print and watch your printer
description: Community server for OctoPrint, Klipper (Moonraker), Duet, Repetier, Prusa Connect, Creality and Bambu Lab printers: check status, upload and start prints, edit STL files (scale, rotate, section), slice with your slicer. Talks to the printer on your network with the key you give it.

config.label: Printer system
config.hint: octoprint, klipper, duet, repetier, bambu, prusa or creality

config.label: API key
config.hint: from your printer system's settings (not needed for Bambu)

config.label: Bambu: model
config.hint: p1s, p1p, x1c, x1e, a1, a1mini or h2d

mcp.also: The first run downloads the server package with npm. Slicing needs a slicer installed (PrusaSlicer, OrcaSlicer, Cura or Bambu Studio); status and printing do not.
